_comment: Price registry. This is DATA, not code: adding a model's rates is an
edit here, never a change to run_engine.py, and never a model name
written into logic. The five model ROLES in .env decide which model
runs; this file only says what a model costs once it has run.
A model absent from this file is UNPRICED: cost_usd stays NULL and the
measurement report says the price is not configured. It is never
treated as zero -- a zero would read as 'this call was free'.
Rates are USD per million tokens. Keys are matched against
cost_events.model_name exactly first, then by longest matching prefix,
so a dated snapshot id resolves to its family entry.
MODALITY (migration 022). An entry may give rates directly, which means
TEXT, or give a `modalities` map. gemini-embedding-2 is multimodal and
its modalities are priced 60x apart, so a single rate per model would
charge an audio embedding at the text rate and under-report by 32x.
Lookup NEVER falls back to another modality: an unpriced modality is
UNPRICED and shows up in v_unpriced_spend.
Embeddings have no output tokens, so output_usd_per_mtok is 0.

gemini-embedding-2._source: Supplied by the practitioner 2026-09-10, paid tier. Not guessed: search is unavailable in the build environment and the provider's pricing pages are blocked by the egress proxy.

discounts._comment: Applied only when a caller declares it used these paths.
